blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two different weather systems are forecast to bring rain over various parts of the country on Friday, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) in its latest weather forecast, the northeast monsoon or “amihan” will continue to affect and bring rain over parts of Northern Luzon, particularly the Ilocos Region, Cagayan Valley, and the Cordillera Administrative Region. Meanwhile, high chances of rain are also forecast over parts of Southern Luzon due to the easterlies, specifically Quezon Province and Bicol Region.
